corrections: Enable source preparation and memory diagnostics for the existing N4 profile marker as well as N3.

Twelve source-fixed symbolic recorders now accept the existing explicit 36/40 GiB worker envelopes, while each recording remains capped at 32 GiB. Exact reservation ownership, census, categories, source geometry and device limits remain checked.

Focused tests exercise actual recording on 32/36/40 GiB worker ledgers, oversized recording rejection, foreign reservation rejection, unsupported worker profile rejection and complete reservation retirement.
Requalified 317 native and 72 registered descriptor rows across five worker counts; numeric entries exactly match the previous catalog. Only source fingerprints changed.
notes: Failed initial detail/serial attempts are retained as diagnostics and excluded from timing statistics.
An eighth pair was added to balance starting-kernel order after the heldout two-worker case showed an order effect in the first seven pairs. All eight pairs are included in the final statistics.

The first attempt at the eighth pair was refused before execution because a new documentation draft changed the build provenance. The exact measured documentation snapshot was restored, the repetition reran, and the report was saved after profiling.

The metadata-only harness stops with case owners retained and relies on process teardown after measurement; each accepted receipt verifies service termination and reaped children. This does not qualify complete proof-workflow retirement.
The worker host allowance is a logical admission budget. Process MemoryPeak is reported separately and is not the amount reserved by the schedule.
The two N4 fixtures contain four distinct verified public inputs each, composed from deterministic N3 inputs; they are related synthetic fixtures, not independent production workloads.
Overlapping task clocks sum wall time and include waits; they do not measure CPU utilization or GPU busy time.

Earlier six-shape GPU timings measure packing, upload, kernels and readback on synthetic field streams, excluding initialization/warmup. They are operation timings, not complete transaction metadata timings.
Documentation and this evidence file were saved after the measured source snapshot.

prelaunch_refusal.reason: Documentation draft differed from measured build snapshot; refused before execution; restored exact snapshot before retry.
